alphapartners-coupang:greenhouse:7896826.description: 회사 소개 쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다. 쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요. 팀 소개 CLS(Coupang Logistics Service)는 택배사업, 화물운송, 화물주선, 물류창고, 화물분류 등 종합 물류 서비스를 제공하는 쿠팡의 물류전문 계열사입니다. bvp-cloudinary:lever:cb36e787-44af-4b02-.title: Senior AI Integrations & Automation Engineer
bvp-cloudinary:lever:cb36e787-44af-4b02-.description: Cloudinary is building a modern internal business-systems capability inside the MIS function, and this role is at the center of it. You will build and operate the AI and automation infrastructure the company runs on. As well as build the apps, agents, and workflows on top of it that put it to work. This is not an R&D or product role. Your customers are internal — the teams and process owners across Finance, HR, GTM Operations, Security, and IT who depend on well-integrated systems and intelligent automation to do their jobs. You’ll work directly with them to turn real problems into shipped solutions. A senior individual-contributor role reporting to the VP of MIS (CFO Office).
responsibilities: The role spans two connected layers, and you’ll move fluidly between them:

The platform. Build and maintain the shared integration and automation infrastructure layer that connects our internal systems and exposes them to AI safely -  reusable connectors, reliability, security, and observability.

The solutions. Build internal tools, automations, and AI agents on top of it — integrations across enterprise SaaS (Salesforce, NetSuite, Slack, Okta), and LLM-powered workflows for things like triage, provisioning, document processing, and reporting.
The right tool for the job. Low-code/iPaaS, custom code, or a hybrid — whatever delivers value fastest and stays maintainable, with responsible-AI practices throughout.
How You’ll Work
Deliver MVP-first and iterate on real usage; favor pragmatic, simplicity-first solutions over over-engineering
Own what you build end to end — design through production support — with documentation others can maintain
Communicate trade-offs clearly, and quantify the value you deliver
Scope

In scope: the internal AI-integration and automation platform and everything built on it; business infrastructure for teams across Finance, HR, GTM, Security, and IT; integration reliability and observability.
Out of scope: physical IT operations (device provisioning, inventory, AV) and endpoint/office IT support.
qualifications: Core experience
7+ years in integrations, business systems / MIS, or systems engineering within SaaS environments, with senior-level ownership
Hands-on experience integrating systems you don’t control — their APIs (REST, GraphQL, webhooks), auth flows, rate limits, and imperfect data
Proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript (Node.js/TypeScript)
Experience with low-code/iPaaS platforms (Workato, Zapier, Make, Tray) and judgment about when to use them vs. custom code
Experience with AI-to-system integration standards (e.g., MCP)
Familiarity with enterprise systems (Okta, Salesforce, NetSuite, Google Workspace) and with IAM/OAuth, API security, and compliance (SOC 2, ISO, GDPR)
AI & automation
Practical experience building AI-powered workflows, tools, or agents in production
Working understanding of LLM systems — orchestration, tool/function calling, RAG — and a clear sense of when AI is and isn’t the right approach
Execution & ways of working
Deliver in days and weeks, not months: MVP, iterate, scale
Comfortable operating in ambiguity with minimal existing scaffolding
A service mindset toward internal stakeholders, with strong communication and a high bar for documentation and maintainability
Self-driven, proactive, outcome-oriented, and collaborative
Nice to have
Ability to translate business requirements into clear technical definitions and scope
Experience building or operating an internal AI/integration platform used by other teams
Exposure to event-driven architectures or data pipelines
Relevant certifications (e.g., Okta, Salesforce, Workato)

Own the blended CAC model across segments and channels, with clear visibility into how efficiency moves as spend scales and where marginal returns begin to compress. Run a structured financial review cadence: daily pacing checks at the channel level, weekly budget performance reviews with the marketing leadership team, and monthly investment reviews with Finance and senior stakeholders that tie spend decisions to Gross Adds, CAC, and LTV trends. Make and communicate proactive reallocation decisions, with clear rationale grounded in performance data and incrementality signals, not just pacing variance. Maintain forecast accuracy as a core discipline: own the budget model, flag risks early, and frame trade-off decisions with commercial clarity for executive audiences. gigascale-xcimer-energy:lever:469b5bc8-3.description: Xcimer Energy leverages decades of research on Inertial Fusion Energy (IFE) combined with groundbreaking new laser architecture. Our mission is to deploy fusion power plants to meet global decarbonization goals as fast as possible. Supported by leading investors, Xcimer is uniquely positioned to deliver limitless, clean, fusion power to combat climate change. Join us in powering a better world with inertial fusion! This is a full-time, onsite role based at our Tucson, AZ facility. As an Warehouse Operations Specialist you will be responsible for overseeing daily warehouse, shipping, receiving, and inventory control operations while ensuring accuracy, efficiency, safety, and compliance with company procedures. This role provides leadership and guidance to warehouse personnel, coordinates material movement throughout the facility, maintains inventory integrity, and supports production operations by ensuring the timely receipt, storage, and shipment of materials and finished goods. We are looking for leaders who apply their organizational skills, attention to detail, problem-solving abilities, and commitment to operational excellence to positively impact the future of energy!
responsibilities: Team Leadership:  Lead, train, mentor, and support Shipping/Receiving/Inventory personnel while promoting a culture of safety, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

Shipping Operations:  Coordinate and oversee the preparation, packaging, labeling, and shipment of materials, components, and finished goods to ensure on-time delivery and compliance with customer and carrier requirements.
Receiving Operations:  Oversee incoming material receipt, inspection, verification, and documentation to ensure accuracy and timely processing of deliveries.
Inventory Management:  Maintain inventory accuracy through cycle counting, inventory audits, stock reconciliation, and transaction verification while ensuring proper inventory controls are followed.
Material Coordination:  Coordinate the movement of raw materials, work-in-process inventory, and finished goods throughout the facility to support production schedules and operational requirements.
Warehouse Organization:  Ensure materials are properly identified, stored, organized, and traceable while maintaining efficient warehouse layouts and storage practices.
Inventory Control:  Monitor inventory levels and collaborate with purchasing, planning, and production teams to support replenishment activities and prevent material shortages.
Documentation & Recordkeeping:  Ensure accurate completion and maintenance of shipping documents, receiving records, inventory transactions, bills of lading, and warehouse documentation.
Quality Assurance:  Verify incoming and outgoing materials for damage, discrepancies, and compliance with quality standards while supporting corrective actions when issues arise.
Equipment Operation:  Safely operate and oversee the use of forklifts, pallet jacks, hand trucks, and other material handling equipment.
Continuous Improvement:  Identify opportunities to improve warehouse efficiency, inventory accuracy, material flow, and operational performance through process improvements and Lean initiatives.
Workstation Maintenance:  Maintain a clean, organized, and safe warehouse environment while supporting 5S initiatives and facility housekeeping standards.

Safety Compliance:  Ensure strict adherence to all company safety policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements, including proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE) and material handling practices.

Collaboration & Communication:  Work closely with production, purchasing, planning, quality, logistics, and management teams to coordinate material availability, resolve issues, and achieve operational objectives.
qualifications: Education:   High school diploma or equivalent required. Associate degree or technical training in logistics, supply chain, inventory management, or a related field is preferred.
Experience: Minimum of 4–6 years of experience in shipping, receiving, inventory control, warehouse operations, or logistics, with prior leadership or lead experience preferred.
Demonstrated experience leading or coordinating warehouse, shipping, receiving, inventory, or logistics personnel in a manufacturing or distribution environment.
Strong knowledge of inventory control practices, cycle counting, inventory reconciliation, material traceability, and warehouse operations.
Experience with shipping documentation, receiving procedures, freight carriers, packaging requirements, and transportation logistics.
Ability to utilize ERP systems, warehouse management systems (WMS), barcode scanners, inventory software, and Microsoft Office applications.
Strong attention to detail and accuracy in inventory transactions, material handling, documentation, and shipment verification.
Ability to identify inventory discrepancies, shipping issues, process inefficiencies, and implement corrective actions to improve performance.
Strong organizational, planning, and time-management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks and coordinate workflow effectively.
Effective verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate across departments and provide clear direction to team members.
Ability to foster a positive team environment while working collaboratively with production, quality, supply chain, and management personnel.
Experience operating forklifts, pallet jacks, and warehouse equipment. Forklift certification or the ability to obtain certification is preferred.
Ability to stand, walk, bend, lift, and move materials throughout the workday, including lifting up to 50 pounds as needed.
Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Liderarás la adquisición de nuevos negocios y clientes, y las relaciones de largo plazo con ellos, coordinando estrategias de venta y postventa.
